message:
As we take a moment to think about being prepared, it’s a great time to rediscover some low-tech fun! Planning and getting ready for different situations can be a wonderful family activity, bringing us together in a meaningful way. 

Whether it’s mapping out our escape routes or organizing our emergency kits, these simple tasks can spark creativity and teamwork. Plus, there’s something satisfying about doing things the old-fashioned way, isn’t there? Let’s make this a bonding experience rather than a chore. 😊
